d: Donald Trump is set to attend his first Quad leaders’ meeting, bringing together the United States, India, Japan and Australia on the sidelines of the ASEAN Summit in Manila. The meeting comes amid questions over Washington’s commitment to the grouping, after Trump skipped previous Quad leaders’ summits while Secretary of State Marco Rubio continued diplomatic engagement with its members. With Trump also preparing for talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping, the timing of the meeting carries significance for the Indo-Pacific and the US-China relationship.
